certifications.name: Certification of Capability in Business Analysis

kaPlainNames.planning: Planning analysis work and coordinating with people
kaPlainNames.elicitation: Talking to people to understand their needs
kaPlainNames.lifecycle: Managing changes and keeping requirements up to date
kaPlainNames.strategy: Understanding business problems and recommending approaches
kaPlainNames.radd: Detailing requirements and comparing solution options
kaPlainNames.evaluation: Checking whether a solution delivers the expected results

activities.label: Plan analysis work, coordinate tasks and engage stakeholders
Interview users, run workshops or gather feedback
Document business needs or clarify requirements
Review changes, trace requirements or prioritize a backlog
Study business problems, processes or opportunities
Build business cases, compare options or recommend improvements
Write user stories, acceptance criteria, process models or specifications
Review proposed designs or validate requirements with users
Test whether a solution meets business needs or measure its benefits
Track outcomes, user adoption or suggest improvements after delivery

certifications.name: Entry Certificate in Business Analysis
certifications.description: A strong starting point for people entering business analysis, including career changers and experienced professionals transitioning into BA.

certifications.name: Certification of Capability in Business Analysis
certifications.description: Requires 3,750 BA work hours in the last 7 years, with specified knowledge-area distribution.

certifications.name: Certified Business Analysis Professional
certifications.description: Requires 7,500 BA work hours in the last 10 years, including at least 900 hours in each of 4 BABOK areas.

certifications.name: Certification in Business Data Analytics
certifications.description: For professionals using data to inform business decisions; no mandatory work-experience threshold.

certifications.name: Agile Analysis Certification
certifications.description: For professionals interested in Agile and product delivery; no mandatory work-experience threshold.

certifications.name: Certificate in Cybersecurity Analysis
certifications.description: For professionals interested in cybersecurity analysis; no mandatory work-experience threshold.

certifications.name: PMI Professional in Business Analysis
certifications.description: Requires 24, 36 or 60 non-overlapping months of BA experience within the last 8 years, depending on education. Exact months need checking.
